title: Founder Access Continuity Organizer
method: Read-only web search + public listing pages for business-continuity, emergency-access and digital-legacy products. Prices are each page's own displayed price at the time observed. No purchase, no account, $0.

competitors.name: The Divine Business Legacy Vault
competitors.notes: Most direct business comparable. Fillable vault: password/login tracker, social vault, business financial accounts log, digital products inventory, subscriptions tracker, key contacts, business succession plan, letter to successor. For women entrepreneurs.
competitors.verified_by: Claude (web search of the live product page showing $37)

competitors.name: IF I CAN'T - Personal Continuity & Emergency Takeover System
competitors.notes: Closest conceptual comparable: a Notion command center so life keeps running if you are in hospital, unreachable or gone. Explicitly 'map not vault', organizational only, no password vault, built for Owner + Helper.
competitors.verified_by: Claude (web search of the live product page showing $49)

competitors.name: The Solo Ager Planner - Life, Legacy & Emergency Plan (Notion)
competitors.notes: Asset & Account Inventory that maps what exists and where it is documented (never the account numbers themselves), plus an 'If This Happens' page with five scenarios (hospitalization, unreachable 48h, incapacity, death).
competitors.verified_by: Claude (web search of the live product page showing $39)

competitors.name: Business Continuity Plan (The Aligned Way)
competitors.notes: Thin 2-page plan: key contacts, critical business functions, key risks, response plan, data/financial continuity, reviewed once or twice a year. Shows the floor for a template-only continuity product aimed at small owners.
competitors.verified_by: Claude (web search of the live product page showing $20.22)

competitors.name: Business Continuity Plan Template (Our Cloud Security)
competitors.notes: NIST SP 800-34 structured BCP template (.docx): business impact analysis with RTO/RPO/MTD tables, authority matrix, critical vendor registry, test schedule and records. Enterprise-oriented.
competitors.verified_by: Claude (web search of the live product page showing $47)

competitors.name: Business Continuity & Cyber Readiness Kit - 6 Editable Templates
competitors.notes: 6 Word templates + 6 fillable PDFs: business impact analysis, continuity/DR plan, call tree, cyber incident response, IT security policy starter, systems/vendor/backup register. Displayed $79 (list $118).
competitors.verified_by: Claude (web search of the live product page showing $79)

competitors.name: The Twenty Page Emergency Binder
competitors.notes: 22-page PDF (A4 + US Letter) for households: first call order, professionals, hospital/death pages, accounts by name, papers, and 'digital access: how to reach the accounts safely, without writing a single password down' - the same never-write-a-password doctrine as this product.
competitors.verified_by: Claude (web search of the live product page showing $19)

competitors.name: Digital Legacy Planner Bundle (64 files)
competitors.notes: 64 printable/fillable files + an Excel workbook for password and account tracking, financial worksheets, insurance/asset records, emergency information forms, subscription logs. Bundle sold at a single low price.
competitors.verified_by: Claude (web search of the live listing showing $19.00)

competitors.name: The Family Emergency Binder (75-page illustrated PDF)
competitors.notes: 75 pages, 20 chapters, 24 worksheets, 20-tab binder structure; privacy-first with nine handling rules and clear instruction never to write passwords, PINs or full account numbers on paper. Displayed $6.75 (list $9).
competitors.verified_by: Claude (web search of the live product page showing $6.75)

competitors.name: Emergency Preparedness Binder (Family, Medical, Financial & Legal Organizer)
competitors.notes: Digital PDF organizer for family/medical/financial/legal information. Price read from the product's own checkout page (US$7.99).
competitors.verified_by: Claude (web search of the live checkout page showing US$7.99)

competitors.name: Business Administration Toolkit (The Billable Hour)
competitors.notes: 10 administrative templates, 30+ pages, one editable .docx; includes an Emergency Contacts & Business Continuity Plan module, a subscription/software tracker and a document retention schedule.
competitors.verified_by: Claude (web search of the live product page showing $79)

competitors.name: Trevenco BCM Starter Kit (SME Edition)
competitors.notes: Business impact analysis with impact timelines, risk register with probability x impact scoring, BCM policy, incident scenarios and a crisis checklist; built by a working BCM manager. English + Czech.
competitors.verified_by: Claude (web search of the live product page showing $67.73)

competitors.name: Emergency Plan Bundle (ReadyOps AI)
competitors.notes: Four editable plans (Emergency Action, Business Continuity, Crisis Comms, Disaster Recovery), Word + PDF, per-company license, quarterly updates.
competitors.verified_by: Claude (web search of the live product page showing $49)

competitors.name: LifeVault Secure - Single Document template
competitors.notes: One-time single-template price for guided estate/continuity planning drafts; also offers a free Digital Executor Checklist and an Emergency Binder Template as lead magnets. Shows a subscription platform pricing its template-only entry point.
competitors.verified_by: Claude (web search of the live vendor pricing page showing $19.99)
